name: dup_code
description: Near-duplicate code blocks: windows of normalized lines hashed, merged into groups with file/start/end

path.description: directory or file to scan (default: project root)

window.description: significant lines per hashed window; the smallest block reported (default 6)

min_block.description: drop groups shorter than this many significant lines (default 6)

lang.description: only this language/extension: python, go, javascript, typescript, rust, java, c, cpp, ruby, php, shell, sql... (default: all code)
